exposure: clinical management of mothers infected with HIV
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women infected with HIV who were managed at National Taiwan University Hospital (NTUH) between January 2005 and December 2016, and their infants.
finding: The mother-to-child transmission rate of HIV was 0% at NTUH after the implementation of perinatal HIV interventions.
followup_time: up to 20 months (for definitive HIV exclusion)
